name: Witch Doctor: Spirit Glaive lowers Shadow Resistance by level + 1 (#272)
contract: Spirit Glaive 806289 reads: 'Toss spectral glaives that strikes enemies it passes through, dealing Shadow damage, and reducing their Shadow Resistance by ${1*$PL+1} for $d' (5 sec, SpellDuration 28); its debuff tooltip reads 'Shadow Resistance reduced.' Effect 2 is the Shadow-school (misc 32) resistance aura that carries that reduction, so a level-80 doctor's glaive must lower the target's Shadow Resistance by 81 while the debuff lasts and restore it afterwards. No client record gives it a percentage increase of Shadow damage taken, so the target's incoming Shadow damage modifier must stay unchanged (the report's 15% damage-taken recollection is not what the live client describes). The glaive's own SpellVisual 540 has no missile model (only a right-hand precast model and throw animation), so a thrown projectile is not observable server-side.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Bow for the glaive's ranged-weapon requirement
Spirit Glaive in front of the doctor
The glaive is cast over time, so the client plays its precast hand model
No Shadow damage-taken increase rides on the debuff
Shadow Resistance returns when the debuff ends
